scientific_integrity: Exact algebraic proof; stand-alone symbolic checker rerun. Best-knowledge originality, incomplete access to one delayed-process article; no independent review.
scientific_limitations: Only local exponential stability for two communities, two actions, positive affine game rewards with a strict interior mixed ESS, and positive action-independent constant migration. Oscillatory witness concerns decaying linear modes; no global/noisy/delayed/multi-community theorem. Special-case overlap with unindexed rank-one feedback theory cannot be excluded.
title: Directed two-community games: robust mixed-state stability with oscillatory relaxation
